rules.sentence: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma presents at an advanced stage more frequently than CUC and is associated with worse survival.
The poor response of sarcomatoid UC to chemotherapy has been confirmed by some other studies.
Contrary to these, it has also been reported that NAC provides a survival advantage in these patients.
As they show PD-L1 overexpression, anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy can be a treatment choice for these patients.
